in_latin.name: Adi
in_latin.meaning: From Hebrew origin, meaning 'my witness' or 'I testify'.
in_latin.long_meaning: Adi is a shortened form of Hebrew names beginning with Ad- or Ed-, signifying 'my witness' or 'I testify'. In early Christian tradition, the name Adi was used to signify faithfulness and loyalty. As a given name, Adi conveys a sense of reliability and trustworthiness, reflecting the qualities of a devoted follower of Christ.
